tests.name: patch_shared_prefix_deep
tests.intent: Verify that consecutive patch operations with long shared prefixes execute correctly and produce the expected JSON output.

tests.name: patch_inplace_shared_prefix_deep
tests.intent: Verify that patch_inplace correctly handles deeply nested paths sharing a long prefix over multiple operations exceeding the step cache threshold.

tests.name: patch_token_boundary_divergence
tests.intent: Verify path resolution when paths share a prefix up to a non-token boundary versus a token boundary.

tests.name: patch_prefix_relationship
tests.intent: Verify patch operations where one path is a strict prefix of another consecutive path.

tests.name: patch_insert_remove_above_cached
tests.intent: Verify that structural modifications above a cached path step do not invalidate correct resolution in subsequent steps.

tests.name: patch_removal_vanish_cached_path
tests.intent: Verify behavior when a patch operation removes the container referenced by a previously cached path.

tests.name: patch_many_steps_threshold
tests.intent: Exercise exactly and around 16 cached steps to cross the threshold where deepest_shared_step is engaged.

tests.name: ordered_json_patch_deep
tests.intent: Verify that ordered_json correctly supports the optimized prefix patch resolution for deep structures.

tests.name: patch_alternating_branches
tests.intent: Verify correct caching behavior when patch operations alternate between completely different deep branches.

tests.name: patch_single_step_cache
tests.intent: Verify behavior when step count is low (size 1) so that the optimization branch is bypassed.

tests.name: patch_empty_patch
tests.intent: Verify that an empty patch collection is handled gracefully without triggering cache errors.

tests.name: patch_invalid_json_pointer_prefix
tests.intent: Verify error handling when a patch operation specifies an invalid pointer prefix after a valid one.

tests.name: patch_inplace_multiple_operations
tests.intent: Verify patch_inplace correctly updates a document in place across multiple sequential modifications.

tests.name: patch_deep_nested_array_indices
tests.intent: Verify patch application on deeply nested array indices sharing long array-path prefixes.

tests.name: patch_diff_generated_patch
tests.intent: Verify that a patch generated by json::diff can be successfully applied back via patch().

tests.name: patch_with_numeric_keys
tests.intent: Verify patch handling when object keys contain numeric strings mixed with slash delimiters.

tests.name: patch_escaped_json_pointers
tests.intent: Verify patch performance and correctness with escaped characters (~0 and ~1) in deep shared paths.

tests.name: patch_rapid_succession_unrelated
tests.intent: Verify behavior when multiple unrelated patch operations are applied in rapid succession.

tests.name: patch_copy_move_operations
tests.intent: Verify copy and move patch operations interacting with cached path resolution.

tests.name: patch_test_operation_success
tests.intent: Verify JSON patch test operations sharing deep paths and correctly succeeding.
